title: 2016 YABANCI DİL BİLGİSİ SEVİYE TESPİT SINAVI (YDS) İNGİLİZCE (Sonbahar Dönemi)

questions.questionText: 1. There is new ---- that dinosaurs were warm-blooded like birds and mammals rather than cold-blooded like reptiles.
questions.explanation: Dinozorların sürüngenler gibi soğukkanlı olmaktan ziyade kuşlar ve memeliler gibi sıcakkanlı olduklarına dair yeni bir 'kanıt' (evidence) bulunduğu belirtilmektedir.
options: A) compulsion
B) frustration
C) evidence
D) significance
E) fulfillment

questions.questionText: 2. The tendency towards increasingly bitter chocolate has its origins in the ---- fall in cocoa prices in the 1980s.
questions.explanation: Giderek daha acı çikolataya olan eğilimin kökeninin 1980'lerde kakao fiyatlarındaki 'ani / çarpıcı' (dramatic) düşüşe dayandığı ifade edilmiştir.
options: A) dramatic
B) permanent
C) empirical
D) subtle
E) hectic

questions.questionText: 3. An understanding of the physiology of stress does not ---- clarify its meaning, thus several models have been constructed in an attempt to better define and explain it.
questions.explanation: Stresin fizyolojisini anlamanın, onun anlamını 'tamamen' (completely) açıklığa kavuşturmadığı (does not completely clarify), bu yüzden tanımlamak için çeşitli modellerin oluşturulduğu anlatılıyor.
options: A) arguably
B) jointly
C) eventually
D) completely
E) desperately

questions.questionText: 4. That we have the ability to detect and ---- minute differences in the fat content of food suggests that this ability must have had considerable evolutionary importance.
questions.explanation: Gıdaların yağ içeriğindeki çok küçük (minute) farklılıkları tespit etme ve 'ayırt etme' (discriminate) yeteneğimizin önemli bir evrimsel önemi olması gerektiği belirtiliyor.
options: A) discriminate
B) turn down
C) undermine
D) cope with
E) carry out

questions.questionText: 5. Children who are securely attached to their mother by the time they enter their second year of life are better equipped to ---- new experiences and relationships.
questions.explanation: Annelerine güvenle bağlanan çocukların, hayatlarının ikinci yılına girdiklerinde yeni deneyimler ve ilişkilerle 'başa çıkmak / üstesinden gelmek' (cope with) için daha donanımlı oldukları ifade edilmektedir.
options: A) depend on
B) turn down
C) refrain from
D) cope with
E) carry out

questions.questionText: 6. The success of advertising ultimately ---- whether it influences consumer behaviour.
questions.explanation: Reklamcılığın başarısının nihayetinde tüketici davranışını etkileyip etkilemediğine 'dayandığı / bağlı olduğu' (rests on) belirtilmiştir.
options: A) breaks in
B) disposes of
C) gives away
D) rests on
E) tears apart

questions.questionText: 7. Although Immanuel Kant, one of the greatest thinkers in the history of philosophy, ---- many pieces of technical terminology to articulate the themes of his critical philosophy, perhaps none ---- more pervasive than a priori.
questions.explanation: Kant'ın felsefe tarihinde teknik terminolojiyi 'tanıtması/sunması' geçmişte yaşanmış bitmiş bir eylem (introduced); 'a priori' teriminin şu an bile 'yaygın olması' ise genel bir gerçektir (is).
options: A) was introducing / was
B) introduced / is
C) had introduced / had been
D) used to introduce / has been
E) had been introducing / would be

questions.questionText: 8. In cultures that ---- up to more recent times, we ---- further clues to past beliefs.
questions.explanation: 'Daha yakın zamanlara kadar ulaşan/hayatta kalan' anlamı için Present Perfect (have survived); 'bulabiliriz/bulma ihtimalimiz var' anlamı için bir modal olan 'may find' uygundur.
options: A) will survive / need to find
B) had survived / could find
C) survived / would find
D) survive / used to find
E) have survived / may find

questions.questionText: 9. The Internet provides a platform which enables new products ---- more rapidly since it is possible ---- new ideas and concepts through online research.
questions.explanation: 'Enable something to be done' kuralı gereği 'to be developed' (yeni ürünlerin geliştirilmesini sağlamak); 'it is possible to do something' kuralı gereği 'to test' (test etmek mümkündür) kullanılır.
options: A) being developed / testing
B) to develop / to have tested
C) developing / to be tested
D) to be developed / to test
E) having developed / being tested

questions.questionText: 10. Education plays an important role ---- improving people's health, and educated people are more likely to be informed consumers of health care, gathering information ---- diseases and potential treatments.
questions.explanation: Bir şeyi iyileştirme'de' (in improving) rol oynamak ve hastalıklar 'üzerine/hakkında' (on diseases) bilgi toplamak edat uyumunu sağlar.
options: A) to / upon
B) in / on
C) at / about
D) with / from
E) for / over

questions.questionText: 11. Excluding minor skin cancers, breast cancer is the single most common type of cancer ---- women based ---- American Cancer Society data.
questions.explanation: Kadınlar 'arasında' (among) en yaygın kanser türü ve veri veya araştırmalara 'dayanarak' (based upon / based on) anlamlarını veren edatlar C şıkkındadır.
options: A) in / from
B) with / for
C) among / upon
D) within / about
E) on / of

questions.questionText: 12. ---- some people produce irresistibly scented sweat that insects can detect from 30 m away, they are especially attractive to mosquitoes.
questions.explanation: Bazı insanlar böceklerin uzaktan tespit edebileceği kokulu ter ürettikleri 'için / ürettiklerinden' (As), sivrisineklere daha cazip gelirler (Sebep-sonuç ilişkisi).
options: A) Until
B) As
C) Whereas
D) Whether
E) Before

questions.questionText: 13. ---- using renewable energy is potentially a means of combating global warming, renewable energy facilities can be very expensive to establish.
questions.explanation: Yenilenebilir enerji kullanımı küresel ısınmayla mücadelenin bir aracı olmasına 'rağmen' (Although), tesisleri kurmanın çok pahalı olması bir zıtlıktır.
options: A) Unless
B) Although
C) Just as
D) Until
E) When

questions.questionText: 14. Standard Mail Transfer Protocol employs an elaborate letter-and-number code that tells each computer station what it must do with a message ---- it can reach its destination.
questions.explanation: Mesajın hedefine ulaşabilmesi 'için / ulaşabilsin diye' (so that) her bilgisayar istasyonuna ne yapması gerektiğini anlatan bir kod kullanılır (Amaç bildirir).
options: A) as though
B) in case
C) so that
D) even if
E) now that

questions.questionText: 15. Leonardo da Vinci's drawings for machines are ---- accurate ---- it has been possible for modern engineers to build some of them.
questions.explanation: Çizimler 'o kadar' isabetlidir 'ki' (so ... that), modern mühendislerin bazılarını inşa etmesi mümkün olmuştur.
options: A) so / that
B) as / as
C) either / or
D) more / than
E) neither / nor

questions.questionText: 16. ---- the promising prospects that carbon capture and storage technology offers to prevent air pollution, it is still a rather new technique requiring much more research before it can be utilized on a large scale.
questions.explanation: Sunduğu umut verici beklentilere/ihtimallere 'rağmen' (In spite of), büyük ölçekte kullanılmadan önce çok daha fazla araştırma gerektirmesi bir zıtlık oluşturur.
options: A) Owing to
B) Rather than
C) In spite of
D) Similar to
E) Except for

questions.questionText: 17. Great Britain was one of the most powerful nations in the world in the 18th century. It led the world in (17)---- new sources of energy for making textiles and concentrating the process in factories.
questions.explanation: Tekstil üretmek için yeni enerji kaynaklarından 'faydalanmada / onları kullanmada' (utilising) İngiltere'nin dünyaya öncülük ettiği anlatılmıştır.
options: A) accelerating
B) utilising
C) challenging
D) eliminating
E) recruiting

questions.questionText: 18. Thereafter, the proportion of manufacturing carried out in northern factories steadily rose (18)---- individual and primitive ways of production.
questions.explanation: Kuzey fabrikalarındaki imalat oranının, bireysel ve ilkel üretim yollarının 'aksine / onlara zıt olarak' (as opposed to) sürekli arttığı ifade ediliyor.
options: A) as a result of
B) such as
C) by means of
D) due to
E) as opposed to

questions.questionText: 19. By 1850, Americans were pioneering ways (19)---- clocks and firearms using interchangeable, machine-made parts.
questions.explanation: Saatleri ve ateşli silahları 'seri üretmenin' yolları anlamında 'ways to do something' kalıbına uygun olarak 'to mass-produce' kullanılır.
options: A) to mass-produce
B) to have mass-produced
C) having mass-produced
D) to be mass-produced
E) mass-produce

questions.questionText: 20. Goods poured out of New England and midwestern factories, and they spread (20)---- the world.
questions.explanation: Mallar New England fabrikalarından aktı ve dünyanın 'dört bir yanına / her yerine' (across the world) yayıldı.
options: A) on
B) beyond
C) across
D) against
E) towards

questions.questionText: 21. Industrialization fell behind in the South, (21)--- it was not unknown.
questions.explanation: Sanayileşme Güney'de geride kalmıştı, 'ancak / yine de / her ne kadar' (though) bu durum hiç bilinmiyor değildi (it was not unknown).
options: A) as if
B) though
C) in case
D) only if
E) just as

questions.questionText: 22. Reading does not come naturally; it is a difficult skill that must be acquired painfully. (22)---- learnt, however, it is rarely, if ever, forgotten.
questions.explanation: Ancak 'bir kere / bir defa' (Once) öğrenildiğinde, nadiren unutulur. 'Once' zaman ve koşul bağlacı olarak işlev görür.
options: A) Unless
B) Once
C) Until
D) Before
E) Though

questions.questionText: 23. So, we do not have to worry about forgetting how to read because the skill is (23)---- established in our long-term memory banks.
questions.explanation: Okuma becerisi uzun süreli hafıza bankalarımıza 'sıkıca / sağlam bir şekilde' (firmly) yerleşmiştir.
options: A) coincidentally
B) scarcely
C) firmly
D) moderately
E) severely

questions.questionText: 24. (24)---- the retention of the reading skill in permanent memory, an entirely different type of memory is required during the active process of reading itself.
questions.explanation: Okuma becerisinin kalıcı bellekte tutulmasına 'rağmen' (Despite) - veya orijinal manasıyla kalıcı bellekteki tutulma bir yana / buna karşın - okumanın aktif sürecinde tamamen farklı bir tür bellek (kısa süreli bellek) gereklidir.
options: A) Thanks to
B) In terms of
C) On behalf of
D) Despite
E) According to

questions.questionText: 25. Some of the information acquired while reading (25)---- to long-term memory but much is remembered for just long enough to enable you to understand the text.
questions.explanation: Okurken elde edilen bilginin bir kısmı uzun süreli belleğe 'aktarılabilir' (may be committed - olasılık ve edilgen), ancak çoğu sadece metni anlamaya yetecek kadar kısa bir süre hatırlanır.
options: A) may be committed
B) used to be committed
C) would be committed
D) had better be committed
E) must be committed

questions.questionText: 26. Brain chemistry and structure is altered by experience, and the stability of these physiochemical changes can be associated (26)---- the retention duration of memory.
questions.explanation: Bir şey 'ile' ilişkilendirilmek anlamında 'associated with' edatı kullanılır.
options: A) at
B) for
C) into
D) with
E) upon

questions.questionText: 27. Some estimates indicate that sea levels could rise globally by at least one metre by 2080 ----.
questions.explanation: Deniz seviyelerinin 2080 yılına kadar küresel olarak en az bir metre yükselebileceği tahminleri, 'buzullar eridiği ve daha sıcak denizler genleştiği için' (since glaciers melt and warmer seas expand) şeklindeki gerekçeyle tamamlanır.
options: A) if municipalities immediately take preventive measures
B) though this anticipation is uniform around the world
C) unless a sudden rise in sea levels threatens most cities
D) since glaciers melt and warmer seas expand
E) as coastal areas at extremely low elevations are the most prone to disaster

questions.questionText: 28. The world's cities are home to more than half of the global population ----.
questions.explanation: Dünyadaki şehirlerin küresel nüfusun yarısından fazlasına ev sahipliği yapması, 'bu yüzden (so) altyapı ve kentsel gelişim yatırımları için benzeri görülmemiş bir baskı ve taleple karşı karşıya kalmalarına' yol açar (neden-sonuç uyumu).
options: A) so they are facing unprecedented pressure and demand for investment in infrastructure and urban development
B) until they gain recognition as one of the fastest developing regional players in the local sector
C) since firms around the world are trying hard to sign a contract to get involved in cities' recreation process
D) so that new industrial projects can be designed to deal with the problems resulting from overpopulation
E) but governments hope that public transportation systems will encourage people to get out of their cars

questions.questionText: 29. When someone feels upset about a life event, telling them to cheer up actually makes them feel worse, ---
questions.explanation: Üzgün hisseden birine neşelenmesini söylemek onları aslında daha kötü hissettirir, 'çünkü (because) bu durum sadece duygularının toplumsal beklentilere uymadığını hatırlatır'.
options: A) although pain and sadness are complicated and unpredictable emotions
B) since emotional support in stressful situations has positive consequences
C) because it simply reminds them that their emotions do not conform to societal expectations
D) for it is not easy to get it right, but we should all try
E) but we all have unique coping strategies and individual preferences

questions.questionText: 30. Parts of Antarctica are claimed by seven nations: Argentina, Australia, Chile, France, New Zealand, Norway, and the United Kingdom, ----.
questions.explanation: Yedi ulus Antarktika'nın bazı bölgelerinde hak iddia etmektedir, 'ancak (however) onların toprak talepleri uluslararası toplum tarafından tanınmamaktadır' (their territories are not recognized by the international community).
options: A) given that Antarctica is generally described as having two parts, West Antarctica and East Antarctica
B) but Antarctica is located in the far south, and is extremely cold, even during the summer
C) therefore, it ranks fifth in size among the world's continents, being larger than Australia or Europe
D) for example, about 98 percent of the land area is permanently covered with ice
E) however, their territories are not recognized by the international community

questions.questionText: 31. Children learn that some types of lying are permissible and encouraged; ----.
questions.explanation: Çocuklar bazı yalan türlerinin (beyaz yalanlar) kabul edilebilir ve teşvik edilebilir olduğunu öğrenirler; 'örneğin, hediye vereni kırmamak için sevmedikleri bir hediye karşısında mutluymuş gibi davranabilirler'.
options: A) for example, they can pretend to be happy with a gift they dislike to avoid hurting the giver's feelings
B) however, lying to protect oneself from punishment is a behaviour that appears in very young children
C) therefore, lying to others is most often seen as an interpersonal failure because it damages trust
D) on the contrary, it may seem reasonable to assume that the maintenance of social interaction can require lying
E) as a result, parents are generally upset about their children's lying since it is considered socially unacceptable

questions.questionText: 32. Although there is no standard definition for a smartphone, ---.
questions.explanation: Akıllı telefon için standart/tek bir tanım olmamasına rağmen (Although), 'temel anlamında gelişmiş işlevlere sahip bir cep telefonudur' (it is a mobile phone with advanced functions in its basic sense) diyerek bir genel tanım yapılır.
options: A) it is a mobile phone with advanced functions in its basic sense
B) the first smartphone had a calendar, a calculator, and fax capabilities
C) its applications are not often included when you buy it
D) whether the market for them will grow in the future is not certain
E) the number of users is increasing day by day

questions.questionText: 33. Although the first railroads date back to the mid-16th century used by horsedrawn mining vehicles, ----.
questions.explanation: İlk demiryollarının atlı maden araçlarıyla 16. yüzyılın ortalarına kadar dayanmasına RAĞMEN (Although), 'gerçekten çoğalmaya ve Sanayi Devrimi'ni hızlandırmaya başlamaları 1800'lerin başlarındaydı' (it was in the early 1800s when they began to really proliferate...).
options: A) in 1916, the world's longest continuous rail line was completed - the 5,600-mile Trans-Siberian railroad took 25 years to build
B) railroads continue to dominate as freight carriers in the US and in the rest of the industrialised world
C) it was in the early 1800s when they began to really proliferate and push the Industrial Revolution into high gear
D) trains still rank among the best means of transportation for passengers
E) rail travel was replaced by the automobile in the mid-twentieth century

questions.questionText: 34. While some hunter-gatherer communities exist even today ----.
questions.explanation: Bazı avcı-toplayıcı topluluklar bugün bile varlığını sürdürmesine RAĞMEN (While), 'avcı-toplayıcı çağı yaklaşık on bin yıl önce ilk tarım toplumlarının ortaya çıkmasıyla sona erdi' zıtlığı zaman referanslarıyla iyi örtüşmektedir.
options: A) hunter-gatherer communities lived by searching out food and other things they needed rather than growing or manufacturing them
B) the era of hunter-gatherers ended about ten thousand years ago with the appearance of the first agricultural societies
C) all hunter-gatherers lived during what is called the 'Palaeolithic Era', which means the era of 'Old Stone Age'
D) many gathered the resources they needed for food, for shelter and clothing, and for ritual activities and other purposes
E) scholars usually study the physical remains from hunter-gatherer communities in the absence of written evidence

questions.questionText: 35. It is not an easy decision for company founders to sell their businesses ----
questions.explanation: Şirket kurucularının işletmelerini satması kolay bir karar değildir, 'iyi bir satış anlaşması sahibine ne kadar zenginlik/para getirmeyi vaat ederse etsin' (no matter how much wealth...).
options: A) no matter how much wealth a good sales deal promises to bring to the owner
B) as long as successful entrepreneurs can build companies with great values
C) even though some employees feel betrayed after a company has been sold
D) thanks to being really optimistic about the bright future of their company
E) since whether to sell relies partly on the attitudes of their new customers

questions.questionText: 36. After securing political and economic stability and overcoming severe flooding, ----.
questions.explanation: Siyasi ve ekonomik istikrarı sağladıktan ve şiddetli sellerin üstesinden geldikten sonra (After securing...), 'Tayland bu toparlanma yeteneğiyle artık yabancı yatırımcılar için cazip hale geliyor' (Thailand is now becoming attractive to foreign investors with its ability to recover).
options: A) about half of Thailand's workforce is employed in the agriculture sector
B) the Thai economy depends mainly on automotive and electronics manufacturing
C) Thailand is now becoming attractive to foreign investors with its ability to recover
D) the majority of the population in Thailand are ethnic Thais besides a large ethnic Chinese minority
E) Thailand also exports processed foods like frozen shrimp and canned pineapple

questions.questionText: 37. James Hansen, a climatologist at Columbia University, critically expressed that as long as fossil fuels are the cheapest fuels in the market, they will continue to be used.
questions.explanation: 'Kolombiya Üniversitesi'nde iklim bilimci olan James Hansen' (James Hansen, a climatologist at Columbia University), 'eleştirel bir şekilde ifade etmiştir' (critically expressed that), 'fosil yakıtların piyasadaki en ucuz yakıtlar olduğu sürece kullanılmaya devam edileceğini' (as long as fossil fuels are the cheapest fuels... they will continue to be used). Tam eşleşme C seçeneğidir.
options: A) James Hansen, fosil yakıtların piyasadaki en ucuz yakıtlar olduğu sürece kullanılmaya devam edileceğini eleştirel bir şekilde ifade ettiğinde Kolombiya Üniversitesi'nde iklim bilimciydi.
B) İklim bilimci James Hansen, fosil yakıtların piyasadaki en ucuz yakıtlar olduğu sürece kullanılmaya devam edileceğini Kolombiya Üniversitesi'nde eleştirel bir şekilde ifade etti.
C) Kolombiya Üniversitesi'nde iklim bilimci olan James Hansen, fosil yakıtların piyasadaki en ucuz yakıtlar olduğu sürece kullanılmaya devam edileceğini eleştirel bir şekilde ifade etmiştir.
D) Fosil yakıtların, piyasadaki en ucuz yakıtlar olduğu sürece, kullanılmaya devam edileceğini eleştirel bir şekilde ifade eden, Kolombiya Üniversitesi'ndeki iklim bilimci James Hansen'dı.
E) Kolombiya Üniversitesi'nde iklim bilimci olan James Hansen, fosil yakıtların piyasadaki en ucuz yakıtlar oldukları için kullanılmaya devam edileceğini eleştirel bir şekilde ifade etti.

questions.questionText: 38. There are over 100 trillion bacteria in our body, most of which are in the guts, and they support essential functions like digestion, immunity and mental health.
questions.explanation: 'Vücudumuzda ... 100 trilyondan fazla bakteri vardır' (There are over 100 trillion bacteria in our body), 'çoğu bağırsaklarda olan' (most of which are in the guts), 've bunlar sindirim, bağışıklık ve akıl sağlığı gibi önemli fonksiyonları desteklemektedir' (and they support essential functions like...). En iyi çeviri D seçeneğidir.
options: A) Sindirim, bağışıklık ve akıl sağlığı gibi önemli fonksiyonları destekleyen ve vücudumuzda çoğunlukla bağırsaklarda bulunan 100 trilyondan fazla bakteri vardır.
B) Vücudumuzdaki 100 trilyondan fazla bakterinin çoğu bağırsaklardadır ve bunlar sindirim, bağışıklık ve akıl sağlığı gibi önemli fonksiyonları desteklemektedir.
C) Vücudumuzda bulunan 100 trilyonu aşkın bakterinin çoğu bağırsaklarda yaşar ve sindirim, bağışıklık ve akıl sağlığı gibi önemli fonksiyonları destekler.
D) Vücudumuzda çoğu bağırsaklarda olan 100 trilyondan fazla bakteri vardır ve bunlar sindirim, bağışıklık ve akıl sağlığı gibi önemli fonksiyonları desteklemektedir.
E) Sindirim, bağışıklık ve akıl sağlığı gibi önemli fonksiyonları destekleyen 100 trilyonu aşkın bakteri, vücudumuzda çoğunlukla bağırsaklarda bulunmaktadır.

questions.questionText: 39. Although sleep disorder has negative effects on almost all of the occupations throughout the world, it is a particular source of concern for those who work the night shift.
questions.explanation: 'Uyku bozukluğu dünya çapındaki hemen hemen bütün meslekler üzerinde olumsuz etkilere sahip olsa da' (Although sleep disorder has negative effects...), 'gece vardiyasında çalışanlar için özel bir endişe kaynağıdır' (it is a particular source of concern for those who work the night shift) çevirisini birebir veren E seçeneğidir.
options: A) Gece vardiyasında çalışanlar için özel bir endişe kaynağı olan uyku bozukluğu, artık tüm dünyada hemen hemen bütün meslekler üzerinde olumsuz etkiler yaratmaktadır.
B) Uyku bozukluğu, gece vardiyasında çalışanlar için özel bir endişe kaynağı oluştursa da dünya çapındaki hemen hemen bütün meslekler üzerinde olumsuz etkilere sahiptir.
C) Uyku bozukluğunun tüm dünyada hemen hemen bütün meslekler üzerinde olumsuz etkileri olsa da özellikle gece vardiyasında çalışanlar için ayrı bir endişe kaynağıdır.
D) Uyku bozukluğu, özel bir endişe kaynağı olduğu gece vardiyasında çalışanların yanı sıra dünya çapındaki hemen hemen bütün meslekler üzerinde olumsuz etkilere sahiptir.
E) Uyku bozukluğu dünya çapındaki hemen hemen bütün meslekler üzerinde olumsuz etkilere sahip olsa da gece vardiyasında çalışanlar için özel bir endişe kaynağıdır.

questions.questionText: 40. Albert Einstein, ışığın sürekli bir dalgadan ziyade küçük enerji parçacıklarından, diğer bir deyişle fotonlardan oluştuğunun düşünülebileceği fikrini ortaya koyduğu için 1921'de fizik dalında Nobel Ödülü'nü kazanmıştır.
questions.explanation: Cümlenin İngilizce yüklemi 'Nobel Ödülü'nü kazanmıştır' (won the Nobel Prize), sebebi ise 'ortaya koyduğu için' (for introducing the idea...). E şıkkı bu ana yapıyı, 'Albert Einstein won the Nobel Prize in physics in 1921 for introducing the idea that light can be thought of as being composed of tiny particles of energy, or photons, rather than as one continuous wave' diyerek mükemmel yansıtır.
options: A) Albert Einstein's winning the Nobel Prize in physics in 1921 is due to his idea that light can be thought of as being composed of tiny particles of energy, or photons, rather than as one continuous wave.
B) Albert Einstein proposed that light can be thought of as being composed of small particles of energy, or photons, rather than as one continuous wave, and he won the Nobel Prize in physics in 1921.

C) Albert Einstein put forward the idea that light can be thought of as being composed of tiny particles of energy, or photons, rather than as one continuous wave, and therefore won the Nobel Prize in physics in 1921.

D) Albert Einstein won the Nobel Prize in physics in 1921 when he proposed that light can be thought of as being composed of little particles of energy, oг photons, rather than as one continuous wave.

E) Albert Einstein won the Nobel Prize in physics in 1921 for introducing the idea that light can be thought of as being composed of tiny particles of energy, or photons, rather than as one continuous wave.

questions.questionText: 41. Rüzgar basit tabirle yüksek basınç bölgelerinden daha alçak basınç bölgelerine hava akışı anlamına gelir ve sıvılarla aynı fizik kanunlarına tabidir.
questions.explanation: 'Rüzgar basit tabirle ... hava akışı anlamına gelir' (Wind simply means the flow of air...), 've sıvılarla aynı fizik kanunlarına tabidir' (and it is subject to the same laws of physics as fluids). C şıkkı cümleyi eksiksiz ve en yalın haliyle çevirir.
options: A) What is simply meant by wind is that it is the flow of air from areas of high pressure to those of lower pressure, and it obeys the same laws of physics as fluids.
B) The meaning of wind is simply the flow of air from high pressure areas to lower pressure areas, and in addition to this, it obeys the same physics laws as fluids do.
C) Wind simply means the flow of air from areas of high pressure to those of lower pressure, and it is subject to the same laws of physics as fluids.
D) Wind, which means the flow of air from high pressure areas to lower pressure areas, is subject to the same laws of physics as fluids do.
E) It is simply known that wind means the flow of air from high pressure areas to lower pressure areas, and it is subject to the same laws of physics as fluids.

questions.questionText: 42. Başarılı bir portre ressamı olan Samuel Morse elektromanyetizmayı ilk duyduğunda mesajların bir kablo üzerinden elektrik aracılığıyla nasıl gönderilebileceği üzerine hemen çalışmaya başlamıştır.
questions.explanation: 'Başarılı bir portre ressamı olan Samuel Morse elektromanyetizmayı ilk duyduğunda' (When Samuel Morse, an accomplished portrait artist, first heard about electromagnetism), 'mesajların bir kablo üzerinden elektrik aracılığıyla nasıl gönderilebileceği üzerine hemen çalışmaya başlamıştır' (he immediately began studying how messages could be sent over a wire via electricity).
options: A) As soon as Samuel Morse, a brilliant portrait artist, had heard about electromagnetism, he at once started to study how electricity could be used to send messages over a wire.
B) Samuel Morse, who quickly began studying how messages could be sent over a wire through electricity when he first heard about electromagnetism, was a skillful portrait artist.
C) When Samuel Morse, an accomplished portrait artist, first heard about electromagnetism, he immediately began studying how messages could be sent over a wire via electricity.
D) Having heard about electromagnetism for the first time, Samuel Morse, who was a proficient portrait artist, quickly began studying how messages could be sent over a wire through electricity.
E) What made Samuel Morse, a talented portrait artist, immediately begin studying how messages could be sent over a wire using electricity was that he learned of electromagnetism.

questions.questionText: 43. It is clear from the passage that in order to be a genius, one needs to ----.
questions.explanation: Metnin başında, geleneksel olarak dehanın (genius) diğer herkesten daha yaratıcı ve becerikli olma yeteneği ('ability to be more creative and skilled than anyone else') veya yeni ufukları ilk gören kişi olma özelliği olduğu tanımlanır. Bu da yenilikçi ve yetenekli özelliklere sahip olmak (have the necessary traits that allow him or her to be more innovative and talented than others) anlamı taşır.
options: A) have the necessary traits that allow him or her to be more innovative and talented than others
B) come up with papers which can lead to remarkable scientific breakthroughs
C) be the one with the highest level of understanding of a scientific subject
D) follow the footsteps of Einstein or Newton, two of the greatest minds in the history of science
E) become knowledgeable in multiple fields of science during his or her career

questions.questionText: 44. Why does the author nominate Einstein instead of Newton as the greatest genius of all time?
questions.explanation: Yazar, Newton'ın döneminde bilimle uğraşan çok fazla insan olmadığını, ancak Einstein'ın döneminde Dirac, Heisenberg, Bohr gibi pek çok büyük bilim insanı bulunduğunu ve Einstein'ın 'onların arasında bile özel kabul edildiğini' ('Even amongst them, Einstein was considered special') söyleyerek onu seçme nedenini açıklar.
options: A) Newton failed to make a difference when compared to other scientists of his time no matter how significant his works and findings were.
B) Einstein earned a reputation as the most special one of the great geniuses of his time while Newton did not have many competitors.
C) Einstein had the privilege of collaborating with some of the most successful scientists of his period, including Dirac, Heisenberg and Bohr.
D) Einstein seems to have been more industrious with the theories he developed while Newton was not very inventive.
E) Einstein, with his papers, contributed a lot more to the way we see the Universe than Newton.

questions.questionText: 45. Scientists say "we need another Einstein" when ----.
questions.explanation: Parçanın sonunda 'Hatta şimdi bile, bilimi değiştirecek büyük bir fikrin olasılığından söz ettiğimizde 'başka bir Einstein'a ihtiyacımız var' diyoruz' (when we talk about the possibility of a big idea changing science...) denilmektedir. Bu, bilimi değiştirecek esaslı bir fikre (vision that is supposed to make a substantial change) ihtiyaç duyulduğunda kullanılır.
options: A) they talk about the existence of atoms, as it was proved by one of the theories proposed by Einstein
B) they make reference to one of the ideas presented in the General Theory of Relativity
C) there is a need for some vision that is supposed to make a substantial change in science
D) they want to underline the fact that Einstein can be considered as the father of cosmology and modern astronomy
E) there is a need to establish the relationship between the light and energy

questions.questionText: 46. Which of the following best describes the author's attitude toward Einstein?
questions.explanation: Yazar, Einstein'ın fikirlerinin insan zihninden çıkan en büyük fikirler olduğunu ('greatest ideas ever to come out of the human mind') belirterek ona büyük saygı duymakta ve onu çok 'takdir etmektedir' (appreciating).
options: A) indifferent
B) satirical
C) impartial
D) appreciating
E) disappointed

questions.questionText: 47. Why do governments choose to invest in education and training?
questions.explanation: Metinde 'Hükümetlerin uluslararası rekabet gücünü artırmasının (increase the international competitiveness) az sayıdaki yollarından birinin kaynakları eğitime ve eğitime yatırmak (putting resources into education and training)' olduğu belirtilmiştir.
options: A) To take advantage of the globalization processes and boost their local markets
B) To reduce the number of people who do clerical work and data processing
C) To increase the international competitiveness of their national economies
D) To deal with the negative consequences of globalization in the developing world
E) To increase the number of members of society doing routine production and service work

questions.questionText: 48. The old industrial societies find it hard to battle with the developing countries because ----.
questions.explanation: Metinde eski endüstriyel toplumların geleneksel imalat endüstrilerinin, işgücü maliyetlerinin çok daha düşük olduğu gelişmekte olan ülkelerle rekabet edemediği ('cannot compete with those of developing countries where labour costs are far lower') belirtilmektedir. Bu durum 'işçi çalıştırmanın daha uygun maliyetli olması' (it is cost-effective to hire labour there) ile uyuşur.
options: A) it is cost-effective to hire labour there
B) their manufacturing industries are outdated
C) developing countries have a higher level of state intervention in education
D) they have been exposed to more foreign influence than
E) they have neglected the technological advancements in manufacturing processes

questions.questionText: 49. Which of the following can be inferred from the passage?
questions.explanation: Metinde, rutin üretim yapanların kaybedeceği, yüksek eğitimli uzmanların beceri ve bilgilerine yönelik küresel bir talep olacağı ('skills and knowledge are in global demand') belirtilmektedir. Bu da eğitimli insanların önümüzdeki yıllarda daha değerli olacağını gösterir.
options: A) The manufacturing industries of the industrial societies will flourish with the help of well-educated individuals.
B) The role of education in coping with globalization is decreasing.
C) Well-educated people with specific skills will be highly valued in the global market.
D) Those engaged in data processing will be paid more in the coming years.
E) Globalization has actually not been so influential in blurring the walls around national economies.

questions.questionText: 50. What could be the best title for the passage?
questions.explanation: Metin temel olarak artan küreselleşmenin (globalization) endüstrilere etkisi ve ülkelerin buna cevap vermek için eğitime/insana (education) nasıl yatırım yapmaları gerektiği konusuna odaklanmıştır.
options: A) State Intervention in Education
B) Education and Globalization
C) Industrialization for Globalization
D) Education in Developing Countries
E) Future of Education in Industrial Societies

questions.questionText: 51. As a result of Australia's Millennium Drought, ----.
questions.explanation: Metinde kuraklık sonucunda 'Avustralya'nın koyun nüfusunun %50 düştüğü, pirinç ve pamuk üretiminin bazı yıllarda çöktüğü' (sheep population dropped... rice and cotton production collapsed) belirtilmiştir. Bu da hayvancılık ve tarımsal üretimde keskin bir düşüş (sharp decline in livestock and agricultural production) olduğunu gösterir.
options: A) people were not able to cope with heavy rains and flooding
B) more people began to utilize the Murray River
C) the government came up with plans to restore water supplies
D) fires and dust storms triggered the climate change
E) there was a sharp decline in livestock and agricultural production

questions.questionText: 52. It is clear from the passage that the southwestern US ----.
questions.explanation: Metinde Avustralya ve ABD'nin kuru bölgeleri olduğu, kuraklığa eğilimli oldukları (Both Australia and the US have dry regions...) ve ABD'nin bu konuda Avustralya'dan ders alması gerektiği belirtilmektedir. Bu durum, 'iklimsel yıkıma yatkınlıklarında Avustralya'nın bazı bölgeleriyle belirli bir benzerlik taşıdığını' (bears certain resemblance to...) kanıtlar.
options: A) has already taken some precautions for the anticipated drought
B) bears certain resemblance to some parts of Australia in their proneness to climatic devastation
C) is likely to experience a more severe drought when compared to Australia
D) is luckier than Australia in terms of geographical characteristics
E) tries to make the Colorado River flow to the sea again

questions.questionText: 53. Which of the following can be inferred from the passage?
questions.explanation: Avustralya'nın yaşadığı kuraklığın 'Milenyum Kuraklığı', diğer bölgeler (özellikle ABD) için bir uyanma çağrısı (wake-up call) olduğu vurgulanmaktadır. Bu da bu olayın iklim değişikliğine karşı halkın dikkatini çekebileceği (call public attention) olumlu bir sonuç (positive outcome) olduğunu ima eder.
options: A) The US inevitably experiences the impacts of a drought despite their smart water planning systems.
B) If the US does not collaborate with Australia, it may not recover from the approaching drought.
C) The US seems to be ignorant of the warnings concerning a possible drought.
D) The US should produce effective solutions to drought since its climate is more threatening than that of Australia.
E) One positive outcome of the Millennium Drought is that it can call public attention to climate change.

questions.questionText: 54. What is the main purpose of the passage?
questions.explanation: Yazar, Avustralya'nın felaket niteliğindeki kuraklık deneyimini aktararak, benzer riskler taşıyan ABD'nin bu yaşananlardan ders çıkarması ve akıllı su planlaması yapması gerektiğine işaret etmektedir (Pointing to the need for the US to take lessons...).
options: A) Revealing the basic similarities between the Murray River and the Colorado River
B) Criticising the reluctance of the US to take action to prevent a possible drought
C) Pointing to the need for the US to take lessons from the drought in Australia
D) Emphasizing the disastrous effects of the drought experienced in Australia
E) Explaining how to save limited water supplies and ecosystems destroyed in both Australia and the US

questions.questionText: 55. It is clearly stated in the passage that Greenland's glaciers ----.
questions.explanation: Metinde Grönland'ın büyük miktarda buzullarını kaybetme riskiyle karşı karşıya olduğu ve bunun 'daha fazla deniz seviyesi artışına yol açabileceği' ('which could result in more sea level rise') belirtilmiştir.
options: A) have slowed down their movement towards sea
B) started to melt first with Petermann and Humboldt glaciers
C) have caused an increase in sea levels because of melting
D) have begun to melt from the middle to the edges
E) used to rest in fjords before they moved towards the sea

questions.questionText: 56. According to the passage, lately, it has been declared that ----.
questions.explanation: Son zamanlarda (Recently), Zachariæ Isstrøm buzulunun 2012'de geri çekilmeye başladığı ve dengesizleştiği için 'daha da fazla geri çekileceği' ('unstable and it's going to retreat even more') açıklanmıştır. Bu da geri çekilmenin muhtemelen devam edeceğini (will presumably continue retreating) gösterir.
options: A) when the Zachariæ Isstrøm glacier started to retreat is unknown
B) the Zachariæ Isstrøm glacier has already begun to dump all its ice at sea
C) the Zachariæ Isstrøm glacier is currently in a steady position
D) the Zachariæ Isstrøm glacier will presumably continue retreating
E) the Zachariæ Isstrøm glacier stopped melting in the year of 2012

questions.questionText: 57. The underlined word "accelerated" is closest in meaning to ----
questions.explanation: 'Accelerated', hızlanmış, artmış demektir. Seçenekler arasındaki en yakın anlamlı kelime 'increased' (artmış) kelimesidir.
options: A) evolved
B) increased
C) emerged
D) altered
E) expired

questions.questionText: 58. What does the passage mainly focus on?
questions.explanation: Paragraf genel olarak Grönland'daki buzulların erimesine, denize dökülmesine ve tüm bunların okyanus/deniz seviyelerinin yükselmesi üzerindeki etkilerine (The consequence of melting in Greenland's glaciers) odaklanmaktadır.
options: A) How to prevent Greenland's glaciers from melting
B) The comparison of Greenland's different glaciers
C) The consequence of melting in Greenland's glaciers
D) Research on Greenland's glaciers
E) The disappearance of ice shelves around Greenland

questions.questionText: 59. It is stated in the passage that the Foldscope ----.
questions.explanation: Metinde Foldscope'un Stanford Üniversitesi mühendisleri tarafından icat edildiği, tek bir kağıt tabakasının katlanmasıyla (folded paper) yapıldığı, uygun fiyatlı ve 'kolayca taşınabilir' (easily portable assembly) bir mikroskop olduğu anlatılıyor.
options: A) is an original method to fold paper that children might favour
B) is a new kind of magnifier that can also work without a lens or a LED
C) is an easy-to-carry microscope whose primary material is paper
D) can magnify objects better than many microscopes used in laboratories
E) can also be created by children as it has quite a simple design

questions.questionText: 60. It is clear from the passage that Manu Prakash ----
questions.explanation: Manu Prakash başlangıçta Foldscope'u 'gelişmekte olan ülkelerde hastalıkları teşhis etmenin ucuz bir yolu' ('inexpensive way to diagnose diseases') olarak tasarlamıştır. Bu B seçeneğindeki ifadeyle birebir uyuşur.
options: A) believes that the Foldscope might soon replace the classical microscopes in laboratories
B) initially considered the Foldscope as a cheap way of detecting diseases
C) devised the Foldscope to help the new generation of scientists who look for excitement
D) invented the Foldscope as he was highly interested in microscopic world
E) thinks that students are inspired by the scientists who are candidates for the Nobel Prize

questions.questionText: 61. It is pointed out in the passage that ----.
questions.explanation: Mucitler beta testini başlattığında, altı yaşındakilerden Nobel adayı bilim insanlarına kadar 130 ülkeden 11.000'den fazla kişinin orijinal araştırma projelerinde bunu kullanmak için gönüllü olduğu belirtiliyor. Bu durum 'dikkat çekici çeşitlilikteki insanların Foldscope'u çalışmalarında kullanmaya istekli olduğunu' (a remarkable variety of people were willing to use...) gösterir.
options: A) the beta test showed that the Foldscope could work well in real practice
B) a remarkable variety of people were willing to use the Foldscope in their studies
C) the Foldscope produces the most reliable results in the study of bee parasites or micro-fossils
D) scientists nominated for the Nobel Prize helped the six-year-olds to use the Foldscope in the beta test
E) many similar experiments were reproduced to see the efficiency of the Foldscope

questions.questionText: 62. The author is of the opinion that the Foldscope ----.
questions.explanation: Yazar pasajın sonunda 'Keşke her biyoloji kitabının son sayfasında bir Foldscope olsa' diyerek sadece bilgi vermenin değil, o bilgiyi elde etme aracını da (araştırma hevesini) sunmanın önemini vurguluyor. Bu da cihazın 'bilimsel çabayı önemli ölçüde destekleyebilecek iyi bir eğitim aracı olabileceğini' (might be a good educational tool that can dramatically foster scientific endeavour) belirtir.
options: A) needs to be greatly improved to be used in original research projects
B) should go beyond biology books and used in laboratories to make detailed studies like those on micro-fossils
C) has become very popular just because the scientists nominated for the Nobel Prize have been using it
D) was originally designed to be used at schools but now it is being utilized especially for medical purposes
E) might be a good educational tool that can dramatically foster scientific endeavour

questions.questionText: 63. Radio Presenter: So, here we have Dr. Henstridge from the University of Edinburgh who analyses people's brains in his lab. How do you persuade people to agree to donate their brain after death? Dr. Henstridge: These are people who participated in a project 70 years ago in which they had their IQ tested. We then sent them a letter so they had the opportunity to think about it with their family without any pressure. Radio Presenter: ---- Dr. Henstridge: It is the only one where we have a good idea about their intelligence levels when they were young.
questions.explanation: Dr. Henstridge 'İnsanların gençkenki zeka seviyeleri hakkında iyi bir fikre sahip olduğumuz tek yer' (It is the only one where...) diyerek neden bu beyin bankasının veya projenin diğerlerinden farklı/özel olduğunu açıklıyor. Radyo sunucusunun sorusu, bu ayırt edici özelliği vurgulayan 'Başka beyin bankaları da var, sizinkini farklı kılan ne?' (There are several other brain banks, why is yours different?) olmalıdır.
options: A) What kind of information is gained in your project by analysing donated brains?
B) Can you tell us a bit about the profile of those people who donated their brain?
C) What's the difference between IQ in the childhood and in the old age?
D) How long are you planning to pursue this research?
E) There are several other brain banks, why is yours different?

questions.questionText: 64. Journalist: Can you tell us briefly what accounting is? Accountant: Basically, accounting is a body of principles for recording financial information related to a company's resources and its use in meeting the company's goals. Journalist: ---- Accountant: Preparation for the field is provided by secondary schools, business schools, or universities.
questions.explanation: Muhasebeci bu alan için gereken hazırlığın lise, işletme okulları veya üniversiteler tarafından sağlandığını belirtiyor. Yani gazetecinin 'Muhasebeci olmak için ne gereklidir / nasıl hazırlanılır?' anlamında 'What does it take to be an accountant?' (Bir muhasebeci olmak ne gerektirir?) diye sorması gerekir.
options: A) Why is accounting critical to the functioning of companies?
B) Why did you choose to be an accountant?
C) What makes a successful accountant?
D) What does it take to be an accountant?
E) What are the generally-accepted accounting principles?

questions.questionText: 65. Erkan: According to the psychology magazine I was reading yesterday, people love betting on the World Cup, but making predictions about uncertain events actually reduces the enjoyment in them. Nergis: Why is that? I believe that when you bet in favor of a team, you support that team during the game, and it makes the experience more meaningful and fun for you. Erkan: ---- Nergis: It really doesn't make any sense to me. I think the satisfaction one can get from making the right choice can balance that out.
questions.explanation: Nergis bahse girmenin oyunu eğlenceli kıldığını iddia ediyor. Erkan, okuduğu dergiye dayanarak Nergis'e karşıt görüşü, 'tahmininizin yanlış çıkma ihtimalinin kafanızın üzerinde dolandığını ve bu yüzden oyundan zevk alamayacağınızı' bildirmelidir ki Nergis, 'Bu bana pek mantıklı gelmiyor. Doğru seçimi yapmanın verdiği tatmin bunu dengeleyebilir' diyebilsin. B şıkkı: 'Psikologlar tam tersini söylüyor. Tahmininizde yanılma olasılığının başınızın üzerinde asılı kaldığını ve bu yüzden oyunun tadını çıkaramadığınızı söylüyorlar' anlamına gelir.
options: A) Some people focus on potential gains in life and play to win, while others try to prevent negative outcomes and just want to avoid losing.
B) Psychologists say the opposite. They say the possibility of being wrong in your prediction hangs over your head, so you can't enjoy the game.
C) Well, it was mentioned in an article that people's anxiety level increases when they watch sports events and that people with heart problems should stay away from going to stadiums.
D) You may have a point there, but remember that betting on football matches puts even more pressure on the players in the field.
E) The authors of the article acknowledge that betting on sports events like football can make a person win huge sums of money as well.

questions.questionText: 66. Bilge: I can't believe there are still some people who think the wealthy have limitless leisure time. Kerem: ---- Bilge: Yes, I do. The well-off people I know work 80 hours per week inventing and producing things. Kerem: It seems they don't really have so much free time after all.
questions.explanation: Bilge zenginlerin sınırsız boş vakti olduğunu düşünenlere inanamadığını söylüyor. Kerem bir şey diyor ve Bilge 'Evet, öyle (ediyorum/düşünüyorum). Bildiğim hali vakti yerinde insanlar haftada 80 saat çalışıyor' diyor. Kerem'in 'Gördüğüm kadarıyla onların söylediklerine katılmıyorsun, değil mi?' (I see you disagree with what they say, don't you?) demesi Bilge'nin 'Evet, katılmıyorum' mantığıyla onaylanmasına neden olur.
options: A) Do you think they'd like to have a lot of leisure time?
B) Do you feel it is unfair for us to have limited leisure time unlike them?
C) Do you think they are rich because they have wealthy families?
D) I don't think having a lot of free time means resting a lot, do you?
E) I see you disagree with what they say, don't you?

questions.questionText: 67. Kemal: Can you have a look at this headline? It says ear genes are linked to musical talent. What does that mean? Onur: Well, it suggests musical talent may partly be due to genes determining the structure of the inner ear. Kemal: ---- Onur: OK. If you have an excellent inner ear structure, you can play the tunes you hear without looking at the notes.
questions.explanation: Onur iç kulak yapısını belirleyen genlerin yeteneği etkilediğini teknik/akademik bir dille açıklıyor. Kemal bir soru soruyor ve Onur 'Tamam. Eğer mükemmel bir iç kulağın varsa, notalara bakmadan duyduğun melodileri çalabilirsin' diyerek basit, günlük hayattan bir örnekle daha anlaşılır kılıyor. Demek ki Kemal, 'Bunu halk dilinde (basit terimlerle) ne demek istiyorsun?' ('What do you mean in layman's terms?') diye sormuştur.
options: A) What do you mean in layman's terms?
B) Do you think this can change later with new research?
C) Are you interested in the link between genes and talent?
D) Do you really believe that genes can have an impact on musical talent?
E) Doesn't it sound incredible that genes can be that important?

questions.questionText: 68. Many districts in Arizona are considering the possibility of lowering the age of partial responsibility to 12 due to the increase in the number of crimes committed by criminals under the age of 14.
questions.explanation: Orijinal cümle 'Arizona'daki birçok bölge, 14 yaşın altındaki suçluların işlediği suç sayısındaki artış nedeniyle kısmi sorumluluk yaşını 12'ye düşürme olasılığını değerlendiriyor' demektedir. B şıkkında '14 yaşın altındaki suçluların işlediği suçlar artıyor ki bu da Arizona'daki birçok yerel yönetimin kısmi sorumluluk yaşını 12'ye düşürme ihtimalini değerlendirmesine neden oluyor' şeklinde bu durum bir neden-sonuç (which causes) bağıyla aynı anlama ulaşacak biçimde ifade edilmiştir.
options: A) Many local authorities in Arizona are thinking of lowering the age of partial responsibility to 12 in order to prevent crimes committed by criminals under the age of 14.
B) Crimes committed by criminals under the age of 14 are increasing, which causes many localities in Arizona to consider the possibility of lowering the age of partial responsibility to 12.
C) The possibility of lowering the age of partial responsibility to 12 is considered by many regions in Arizona because criminals under the age of 14 are committing more crimes.
D) The rising number of crimes committed by criminals under the age of 14 will probably force the localities in Arizona to consider lowering the age of partial responsibility to 12.
E) In Arizona, many districts are considering lowering the age of partial responsibility to 12 due to the increasing crimes committed by those under 14.

questions.questionText: 69. Even though there is sufficient water available to cover the demands of the world population, there is a shortage of clean water due to increased pollution.
questions.explanation: Orijinal cümle 'Dünya nüfusunun taleplerini karşılayacak kadar su olmasına rağmen, artan kirlilik nedeniyle temiz su sıkıntısı yaşanıyor' demektedir. C şıkkı 'Artan kirlilik (Increased contamination), dünya nüfusunun ihtiyaçlarını karşılamaya yetecek su bulunmasına rağmen (in spite of the availability of water enough...), temiz su kıtlığına yol açmaktadır (leads to a shortage of clean water)' diyerek yapıyı kusursuz dönüştürür.
options: A) We are consuming clean water in order to satisfy our demands but there is increasing contamination all over the world.
B) It is necessary to have sufficient water to cover the demands of all people as increased pollution causes a shortage of clean water.
C) Increased contamination leads to a shortage of clean water in spite of the availability of water enough to meet the needs of the world population.
D) Despite increased pollution and a shortage of water, there should be enough water to satisfy the demands of people.
E) Because of increased pollution and a shortage of water, we should find enough resources to satisfy our water demand.

questions.questionText: 70. Despite the fact that obesity is one of the biggest causes of preventable deaths after smoking and is linked to chronic diseases, obesity rates keep increasing.
questions.explanation: Cümle 'Obezitenin sigaradan sonra önlenebilir ölümlerin en büyük nedenlerinden biri olmasına ve kronik hastalıklarla bağlantılı olmasına rağmen, obezite oranları artmaya devam ediyor' demektedir. B şıkkı, 'Obezite sıkıntısı çeken insanların sayısı artmaya devam ediyor, her ne kadar (even though) sigarayla birlikte kaçınılabilir ölümlerden sorumlu ana faktörlerden biri olsa ve uzun süreli hastalıklara (chronic diseases) yol açsa da' diyerek aynı fikri korur.
options: A) Although chronic diseases that are associated with obesity and smoking can be avoided, the number of people who die of obesity and who become chronically ill goes up.
B) The number of people who suffer from obesity continues to rise even though, along with smoking, it is one of the major factors that account for avoidable deaths and causes long-term diseases.
C) In spite of being one of the major causes of deaths that can be avoided and resulting in serious diseases, the number of people who are obese is still higher than the number of people who smoke.
D) The rate of obesity and the number of people who smoke continue to go up even though they are the main causes of deaths that can be prevented and are connected with chronic diseases.

E) Obesity and smoking are illnesses that can lead to preventable deaths, and they are associated with chronic diseases; however, people still continue to suffer from obesity and smoking-related diseases.

questions.questionText: 71. Like other interventions, hypnotheraphy can be regarded as effective only if it proves more powerful than a placebo.
questions.explanation: Cümle 'Diğer müdahaleler gibi, hipnoterapi de ancak plasebodan daha güçlü olduğunu kanıtlarsa (only if it proves more powerful) etkili olarak kabul edilebilir' şeklindedir. C şıkkı 'Hipnoterapinin bir plasebodan daha güçlü hale gelmesi şartıyla (Provided that hypnotheraphy becomes stronger...), diğer uygulamalar kadar (as effective as other applications) etkili olarak kabul edilebilir' diyerek aynı anlama ulaşır.
options: A) Hypnotheraphy is similar to other practices in that it is considered as effective as a placebo.
B) Similar to other treatments, hypnotheraphy could be influential even if a placebo is actually stronger.
C) Provided that hypnotheraphy becomes stronger than a placebo, it can be considered as effective as other applications.
D) Even if hypnotheraphy acts as a placebo, it may be as effective as many other treatments.
E) Although it is like other practices, hypnotheraphy can be more effective than a placebo.

questions.questionText: 72. Floating and flying above us are not only the usual suspects - birds, bats, insects - but countless microscopic creatures as well. The discipline of aeroecology explores how animals, plants and other organisms live in, move through and interact with the aerosphere. Instruments are now so precise that these technical observations can spot a single bee at about 45 km away. ----
questions.explanation: Biyolojik varlıkların havada nasıl hareket ettiğini inceleyen aeroekoloji biliminden ve araçların ne kadar hassas olduğundan (45 km uzaktan bir arıyı tespit edebilme) söz edilmektedir. En sona, aletlerin bu hassasiyetini ve yeteneğini tamamlayacak şekilde, E şıkkındaki 'Bu bilim, radar ve telemetri ile hava hareketini izleme yeteneğinin büyümesi sayesinde büyük kazanımlar gördü' (This science has seen huge gains because of the growing ability to track air movement with radar and telemetry) cümlesi çok uygun şekilde konuyu bağlar.
options: A) How animals are sensing, using and adapting to changes in atmospheric conditions is not interesting for some people.
B) A whole world of invisible creatures inhabit the aerosphere, which contains more than 100,000 living things.
C) Air, as an environment, can lead to surprising interactions between living and non-living things.
D) There are still many mysterious organisms that ecologists cannot define.
E) This science has seen huge gains because of the growing ability to track air movement with radar and telemetry.

questions.questionText: 73. People strive for success, which motivates them to continuously strive for greater achievements. However, the strength of this motivation can vary greatly from person to person. People lacking self-confidence tend to give up on a task much sooner than people with a strong belief in their own abilities. People's levels of motivation are also connected to their beliefs concerning the causes of events. ----
questions.explanation: Motivasyonun gücünün kişiden kişiye değişebildiği, özgüveni olmayanların daha çabuk pes ettiği ve insanların motivasyon düzeylerinin olayların nedenlerine ilişkin inançlarıyla bağlantılı olduğu anlatılmıştır. Boşluğa bu motivasyon düzeylerinin neye bağlı olduğunu detaylandıran A şıkkı ('Diğer şeylerin yanı sıra, bir bireyin kendi performansına verdiği değere bağlıdır') gelmelidir.
options: A) Among other things, it depends on the value an individual places on his or her own performance.
B) While some sources of motivation are biological and directly promote survival, others are learned.
C) Because emotions can both trigger and maintain behaviour, they are motivators of human actions.
D) External incentives also act as a motivator for a certain type of behaviour or action.
E) The concept of motivation explains why people strive to achieve particular goals.

questions.questionText: 74. For thousands of years, man and wolf have been together as allies and companions. A natural instinct that bonds them still exists. Drawing on human interactions with wolves, a team of doctors came up with wolf therapy to work towards repairing the empathy and self-esteem deficits among young adults. ---- The progress they make builds their motivation to complete the program and reduces the risk of reverting back to old harmful habits.
questions.explanation: İnsan-kurt etkileşiminden yararlanarak doktorların genç yetişkinlerde empati ve özgüven eksikliklerini onarmaya yönelik 'kurt terapisini' ortaya çıkardığı anlatılıyor. Boşluktan sonra 'Kaydettikleri ilerleme programı tamamlama motivasyonlarını geliştiriyor...' dendiğine göre, terapi ile ilerleme arasındaki bağlantıyı kuran, C şıkkındaki 'Tedavi, rehabilitasyon programlarına katılanların depresyon, anksiyete ve stresini hafifletmek için tasarlanmıştır' açıklaması doğru geçiştir.
options: A) Wolves have been rescued from dire circumstances, including abuse, neglect and abandonment.
B) Treatment centres are technologically advanced and have perfect facilities.
C) The treatment is designed to ease depression, anxiety and stress among those in the rehabilitation programs.
D) One of the challenges that therapists face is the difficulty in obtaining permission to capture wild animals.
E) A wolf has a unique capacity for engaging people's emotions and breaking through their defense mechanisms.

questions.questionText: 75. The way that interpersonal attraction develops is related partly to how we select a mate. Typically, men prefer women with the classic shapely body figure, probably because it signifies youthfulness, good health and fertility. However, there are cultural and ecological influences. ---- In modern Western societies, where heaviness may indicate ill health, men prefer slimmer women.
questions.explanation: Kültürel ve ekolojik etkilerden (farklılıklardan) söz edildikten sonra modern Batı toplumlarında 'zayıf' (slimmer) kadınların tercih edildiği (çünkü obezitenin kötü sağlıkla ilişkilendirildiği) söylenmektedir. Dolayısıyla boşlukta bunun zıttı bir duruma işaret edilmelidir. B şıkkında 'Geleneksel tarım toplumlarında zayıf olmak ciddi bir hastalık anlamına gelebilir, bu yüzden erkekler kadınlarının daha ağır olmasını (heavier) tercih eder' ifadesi bu kültürel karşılaştırmayı mükemmel sağlar.
options: A) In the United States, a woman's physical beauty is considered to be an ultimately important factor in partner-choosing.
B) In traditional agricultural societies, being thin may mean having a serious disease, so men prefer their women to be heavier.
C) If a woman lacks fertility in Far Eastern societies, this may deter men from choosing her as a wife.
D) Youthful appearance, body and facial symmetry have all become points of interest for American men.
E) Traditional societies have the conception that good genes cannot find their place in heavy bodies, which cause women to lose youthfulness.

questions.questionText: 76. (I) The brain is very good at warning us for threats, and it is also skillful at letting us know when a threat no longer exists. (II) However, sometimes this system fails, and unpleasant associations stick around leading to a malfunction thought to be at the root of post-traumatic stress disorder. (III) New research has identified a neuronal circuit responsible for the brain's ability to get rid of bad memories. (IV) The hunt to find medication that can slow or halt the progression of Alzheimer's disease is on. (V) This finding could hold promise for treating a broad range of psychiatric conditions, including post-traumatic stress disorder.
questions.explanation: I, II, III ve V numaralı cümleler beynin bizi tehlikelere karşı uyarması, kötü anılardan kurtulma yeteneğini (korkuyu unutma) sağlayan nöronal devreler ve bunun Travma Sonrası Stres Bozukluğu (TSSB) tedavisiyle ilgisine odaklanmaktadır. (IV) numaralı cümle, aniden 'Alzheimer hastalığının ilerlemesini durduracak ilaç avı devam ediyor' diyerek Alzheimer konusuna sapıp akışı bozmaktadır.
options: A) I
B) II
C) III
D) IV
E) V

questions.questionText: 77. (I) An octopus's skin is covered with pigmented organs called chromatophores. (II) These structures help cuttlefish to hide from enemies by changing colour and texture. (III) It can shift almost any colour to mimic a coral reef, a rock pattern and others, allowing it to become virtually invisible to predators. (IV) The cuttlefish's skin is also highly adaptable and responsive. (V) As well as being used in military camouflage, the team says the findings could also have applications in materials for paints, cosmetics or even electronics.
questions.explanation: Ahtapot ve mürekkepbalığı (cuttlefish) derisindeki renk değiştiren kromotofor hücrelerin yırtıcılardan gizlenme amaçlı biyolojik kamuflaj yeteneğinden (I, II, III) bahsedilmektedir. IV numaralı cümle, genel bir 'derisi son derece uyarlanabilirdir' diyerek tekrara/düzensizliğe düşmektedir. Ancak asıl sorun V. cümlede 'askeri kamuflajda kullanılmasının yanı sıra ekip, bulguların...' demesidir. Takım (team) ve bulgulardan söz edilmesi bir araştırmayı referans aldığını gösterir ancak önceki cümlelerde bir araştırma grubundan bahsedilmiyor. YDS standartlarına göre, konu 'askeri ve kozmetik uygulamalar'a kaydığı için (V) cümlesi de kopuktur ancak orijinal soruda IV numaralı cümle 'mürekkepbalığının derisi' ile ilgisiz bir şekilde konu bütünlüğünü bozmaktadır denilmiştir. (Cevap anahtarına göre 77. soru D (IV) seçeneğidir).
options: A) I
B) II
C) III
D) IV
E) V

questions.questionText: 78. (I) A French company has just developed an artificial heart which has been approved for human testing in many countries. (II) This artificial heart weighs 900 g and consists of two chambers separated by a biological layer. (III) The heart is energised by two lithium batteries, providing over 230 million heartbeats, which corresponds to a five-year life. (IV) If the heart is used universally, it could save the lives of more than 100,000 people suffering from various heart diseases that can now only be cured by a donor heart. (V) Previous attempts to produce a similar device have led to a decrease in heart transplants.
questions.explanation: Paragraf, bir Fransız şirketi tarafından yeni geliştirilen yapay kalbin özelliklerini, ağırlığını, bataryasını ve yaygın olarak kullanıldığında binlerce insanın hayatını kurtarma potansiyelini övgüyle anlatır (I, II, III, IV). Ancak V. cümlede 'önceki benzer girişimlerin kalp naklinde azalmaya yol açtığı' gibi olumsuz bir yargı ile farklı bir istatistiksel gerçeğe/sonuca atlanarak metnin teknolojik tanıtım akışı bölünmektedir.
options: A) I
B) II
C) III
D) IV
E) V

questions.questionText: 79. (I) In 1493, when Christopher Columbus started his second voyage to the Americas, he took sugar cane with him. (II) He planted the continent's first sugar cane in Hispaniola, the site, not coincidentally, of a great slave revolt a few hundred years later. (III) Within decades mills producing sugar proliferated in Jamaica and Cuba, where rainforest had been cleared and the native population had been eliminated by disease or war, or enslaved. (IV) Tobacco and cotton were also grown in the 1700s on Barbados Island plantations by the slaves. (V) The Portuguese created an effective but brutal model, making Brazil into an early boom colony, with more than 100,000 slaves producing tons of sugar.
questions.explanation: Metin genel olarak Kolomb'un şeker kamışını (sugar cane) Amerika kıtasına getirmesini ve sonrasında şeker değirmenlerinin Jamaika, Küba, Brezilya gibi yerlerde köle gücüyle nasıl büyüyüp yayıldığını, yani 'şeker ticareti' çerçevesini anlatmaktadır. (IV) numaralı cümle ise aniden 'tütün ve pamuğun' 1700'lerde Barbados adasında yetiştirilmesine değinerek 'şeker' temalı metin akışını bozmaktadır.
options: A) I
B) II
C) III
D) IV
E) V

questions.questionText: 80. (I) Most house plants need a period of rest during the year when watering must be reduced. (II) The rest period is brought on by the reduction in available light at certain times of the year. (III) When a plant is not watered enough, the soil in the pot becomes quite dry and compacted. (IV) Giving excess water at this time inevitably encourages plant growth. (V) However, if this is not supported by adequate light, it results in poor growth.
questions.explanation: Paragraf çoğu ev bitkisinin dinlenme dönemine (rest period) ihtiyaç duyduğunu (I), bunun azalan ışıkla tetiklendiğini (II), bu dönemde aşırı su vermenin (giving excess water at this time) bitki büyümesini teşvik ettiğini (IV) ancak yeterli ışık yoksa zayıf büyümeyle sonuçlandığını (V) açıklamaktadır. (III) numaralı cümle, bitki yeterince sulanmadığında toprağın kuru ve sıkışık olması hakkında tamamen farklı bir fiziksel duruma değinerek anlam akışını bozmaktadır.
options: A) I
B) II
C) III
D) IV
E) V
